text:
Claire: Heads-up: planned eu-west1 maintenance Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC. Scope: GPU driver bump + fan-sensor firmware alignment. We'll proceed in 10-minute rack cohorts (max 3 racks offline at once).
Hao: Which exact racks and pools are in the first cohort? any Dedicated tenants pinned?
Claire: First cohort: racks e-01..e-04 (pool-eu-main). Second: e-05..e-08 (pool-eu-backup). No pinned Dedicated tenants on e-01..e-04; some Dedicated on pool-eu-main will route to pool-eu-backup. Full mapping in the comm doc.
Priya: KV cache warmup will burn credits. Can we avoid global preseed?
Claire: We'll do canary preseed on two nodes only. Rest will be cold-start to conserve token budget; monitors will watch latency.
Miguel: How long per rack and rollback plan if driver update fails?
Claire: Target 15m/rack including drain/validation. Rollback: re-install previous driver, reboot GPU, rejoin. If rollback doesn't clear, we failover routing to eu-other and open incident.
Noah: ops-bot, create scheduled job and attach runbook?
ops-bot: Job scheduled: 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z-2026-03-25T03:00:00Z. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/eu-gpu-fan-sync. Notifying oncall.
Lina: Network note: last time egress queues spiked. Request: bump egress throttle +25% for the window, 5m ramp-down post-run.
Claire: Agreed, adding to runbook. Also enabling route fallback priority: pool-eu-backup -> pool-us-fallback.
Priya: Any billing hit for spilling to backups? Finance contact?
Claire: Short spike estimated ~€90 extra. Finance notified (p-ing them).
Hao: Paste exact cordon/drain snippet for oncall please.
Claire: Snippet: ```
# cordon + drain
kubectl cordon $NODE
kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=900s
# update firmware/driver
# validation steps
kubectl uncordon $NODE
```
Miguel: Validation thresholds? If p95 latency > 1200ms or KV regen > 700ms we abort.
Lina: Also monitor egress retransmits and packet drops; if >0.5% abort.
Noah: I'll stream capacity and routing delta updates to this thread during the window.
Priya: I'll draft customer notice for Dedicated customers and apps pinned to eu-west1; send 24h and 2h reminders.
Claire: Oncall rotation for the window: Miguel -> Lina -> Hao. Incident channel: #incidents. Pager escalation set.
Miguel: Add telemetry tag maintenance_id=eu-fan-1769999001 to all emitted metrics for easy filter.
ops-bot: Telemetry tag attached to scheduled job metadata.
Claire: Final checklist: 1) Post customer comm 24h/2h. 2) Ops-bot job + runbook link. 3) Network throttle change + ramp-down. 4) KV preseed limited to canaries. 5) Finance cost note. 6) Oncall rotation set. 7) Validation thresholds in runbook.
Priya: Approved.
Hao: Standing by for rollback.
Noah: I'll watch capacity dashboards. Post updates here as cohorts start. :thumbsup:
